description: This file defines the 'Operation' class, representing an API operation within the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides methods to retrieve HTTP attributes, input/output shapes, errors, and context parameters associated with an API operation.

classes.name: Operation
classes.description: Represents an API operation with methods to access its HTTP details, input/output shapes, errors, and context parameters.

methods.name: getHttp
methods.description: Returns an array of HTTP attributes for the operation, including method and request URI.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Retrieves the input shape of the operation, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getOutput
methods.description: Retrieves the output shape of the operation, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns an array of error shapes associated with the operation.

methods.name: getStaticContextParams
methods.description: Returns static context parameters used for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: getContextParams
methods.description: Returns dynamic context parameters used for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: setContextParams
methods.description: Private method that sets context parameters based on input shape members.
